change.summary: Operators must collect and keep product information for five years after placing goods on the market or exporting them. They must also make this information available to authorities upon request.

obligations.text: Make collected information available to authorities upon request.
obligations.quote: The operator shall make available to the competent authorities upon request the information, documents and data collected under this Article.

reasons: Your shop is established in Germany and ships to multiple EU countries, placing furniture and wooden goods as well as leather goods on the EU market.
These product categories fall under the wood and cattle commodities covered by the EU Deforestation Regulation (EU) 2023/1115.
As an operator placing relevant products on the market, you are required to make collected information available to competent authorities upon request.

todos.text: Prepare to provide collected product information, documents, and data to competent authorities upon request
todos.quote: The operator shall make available to the competent authorities upon request the information, documents and data collected under this Article.
